description:
Buyer places order. Buyer api_key required.

Payment rail (choose explicitly at purchase):
- **direct_p2p** (live, non-custodial direct pay): buyer pays the seller directly OFF-platform via the seller's chosen receiving account. Order amount is the protocol/base amount; the payable DISPLAY follows that account's declared currency/instruction (USDC only when the account is USDC/USD — otherwise the seller's currency, "以收款说明为准"). WebAZ does NOT custody, route, validate, or restrict the method/currency. Pass `direct_receive_account_id`. Eligibility is enforced by the SERVER; ineligible → the route's own gate error.
- **usdc_escrow** (on-chain escrow, USDC on Base): funds enter the escrow contract; buyer deposits via wallet on the order page after create. Channel-gated — server rejects when off.
- Any unavailable rail, an omitted rail, or the compatibility-only **escrow** input is rejected. Never auto-switch rails.

usdc_escrow timing: create returns pay_deadline_hours; deadlines re-anchor after on-chain deposit; NO in-protocol fault/compensation — after autoReleaseAt anyone may trigger release to the seller unless disputed on-chain.

Options:
- **B1 cross-border tax**: server auto-estimates duty (seller's est_import_duty_pct × price)
- **B2 privacy**: `anonymous_recipient=true` → PR-XXXXX alias on shipping label
- **B5 donation**: `donation_pct` 0 / 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 5% → charity_fund

anonymous_recipient.description: [B2] Anonymous recipient: system generates PR-XXXXX alias instead of real name (seller label shows alias + address only)

api_key.description: Buyer's api_key (or omit and set the WEBAZ_API_KEY env var)

digital_delivery.description: Game currency, per the quote's buyer_fields + listing_combo. Fixed: listing fields at top level; unit price: listings[]

region.description: if server name is in 2 regions

direct_receive_account_id.description: For payment_rail="direct_p2p": the seller's direct-receive account id to pay. Ignored on non-direct rails.

donation_pct.description: [B5] Per-order donation pct (0 / 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 5). Computed separately + into charity_fund, posted on order complete.

offer_id.description: RFC-032 negotiated offer (off_…) the seller bound to YOUR human. Exclusive with session_token/coupon/multi-SKU. You never send a price: the server reads it as min(offer, listing), never above the offer. An id, not a credential — another human's grant gets OFFER_MISMATCH. NETWORK only; 404 FEATURE_DISABLED while the flag is off; 409 OFFER_INVALID/EXPIRED/USED/MISMATCH/VOID/NO_COUPON. Agents consume, never issue.

payment_rail.description: Payment rail — pass one explicitly. "direct_p2p" (live, non-custodial): you pay the seller off-platform per their receiving account (USDC only as base/reference amount; WebAZ doesn't custody/route/validate currency) — requires direct_receive_account_id; the server runs all eligibility gates (you do not). "usdc_escrow" (on-chain escrow, USDC on Base): funds go to the escrow contract; buyer deposits via wallet on the order page; channel-gated — server rejects when off. The compatibility-only "escrow" input and an omitted rail are rejected.

promoter_api_key.description: Referrer api_key (optional). ⚠️ Only L1 recorded (direct referrer, 70% commission); L2/L3 can't be inferred via MCP, so the undelivered L2/L3 portions go to commission_reserve (protocol reserve, in-only). Full 7:2:1 three-tier chain requires buyer clicking ?ref= URL from webaz_share_link (creates product_share_attribution).

session_token.description: Price-lock session_token (recommended): from webaz_verify_price; guarantees order price = displayed price

shipping_address.description: Shipping address (free text). OMIT to use your saved default — resolved inside the call, never shown to agents. No default saved → ADDRESS_REQUIRED.

name: webaz_place_order
